title: Scope and explicit refresh
lesson: Keep thread notes separate from shared conventions, and explicitly retrieve a corrected record into an active context.
corrections: Restore the Memory / SCOPE & REFRESH title.
17.4–21.3s: show the active r1 context in amber while storage is r2, then turn it green only on explicit retrieval.
Improve inactive thread visibility, use a complete fade, and normalise the soundtrack with a thread-limited topic-local renderer.
transcript: 0–9s: Thread-local notes remain separate from a durable convention stored with an approved source revision. Agent A retrieves that convention.
10–15s: Agent B starts with empty context and retrieves the durable convention rather than the other thread’s temporary notes.
16–22s: A source correction updates storage. B still has the old version until it retrieves the corrected value.
22–26s: Hold the refreshed active context at r2, then fade the complete image to black.
limitations: Scope is separate from durability: Thread A can remain checkpointed while B is active.
Amber highlights version divergence for the viewer; this cut does not implement a freshness validator or permission check.
The approved source and correction are illustrative; no repository integration was executed.
Audio is measured analytically, not listened to.
